prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "smälta". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "melt".
Scene: An ice cube in sunlight with rounded melting edges and a growing clear puddle around it, the solid-to-liquid change unmistakable.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "smälta = melt; picture a solid turning into liquid.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Isen börjar smälta i solen.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
